novel.justification: This is a uniform away-from-support-strata condition: each ancestry relation common to the compatible tuples has, in every tuple, at least one directed path whose coefficient product exceeds a preassigned tolerance. It holds for compact coefficient families with a common ancestral path whose edge magnitudes are bounded away from zero, such as finite-view chains with all active edges in \([c,C]\) for fixed \(c>0\). It is empirically interpretable through simultaneous lower confidence bounds on the finitely many candidate path products.
